### [Introducing Claude Opus 4.5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-5)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-23

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.5, an AI model designed for coding, agents, and computer use, with improved efficiency and accessibility at a new price point of $5/$25 per million tokens.

- Claude Opus 4.5 is available via API (claude-opus-4-5-20251101) and on major cloud platforms, priced at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens.
- It demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in real-world software engineering tests, surpassing Sonnet 4.5 and competition on internal benchmarks while using fewer tokens.
- The model excels at long-horizon, autonomous tasks, showing a 15% improvement over Sonnet 4.5 on Terminal Bench and achieving peak performance in 4 iterations for self-improving AI agents.
- Updates to the Claude Developer Platform, Claude Code, and consumer apps include new tools for longer-running agents and integrations for Excel, Chrome, and desktop.

**Why it matters:** The improved efficiency and reduced cost of Claude Opus 4.5 make advanced AI capabilities more accessible for developers and enterprises, potentially transforming workflows in coding and agentic systems.

### [Introducing Claude Opus 4.7](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-7)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-23

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.7, an improved model over Opus 4.6, with advancements in software engineering, vision capabilities, and creative task completion, while incorporating new cyber safeguards.

- Opus 4.7 demonstrates notable improvements in advanced software engineering, particularly for difficult coding tasks, handling complex, long-running tasks with rigor and consistency.
- The model features substantially better vision with higher resolution image processing and produces higher-quality interfaces, slides, and documents.
- Opus 4.7 includes safeguards to detect and block prohibited or high-risk cybersecurity uses, with its cyber capabilities intentionally reduced compared to Mythos Preview.
- Pricing for Opus 4.7 remains $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, consistent with Opus 4.6.
- Early testing indicates Opus 4.7 catches its own logical faults during planning, accelerates execution, and resists dissonant-data traps that affected Opus 4.6.

**Why it matters:** This release provides a more capable and reliable AI for complex software development and creative tasks, while also introducing new cybersecurity safeguards for responsible deployment.
